name: Fallarbor Town
lines:
I’m having a hard time deciding if I should make
my Skitty evolve or not.
I only have to use this Moon Stone, is all.
It’s so hard to decide, though.
If I make it evolve, it will become much stronger.
But it will look so different, too.

This Nugget I found here...
I suppose I just ought to sell it, huh?
Let me share a little nugget of wisdom, kid.
Don’t hold on to your assets too long.
Cash is king in this world!
